bug_semantics: Attacker-controlled Comment.data is stored without validation and the XML serializer's COMMENT_NODE arm concatenates the literal comment delimiters around node.data. A payload containing '-->' therefore closes the comment early and makes the following bytes live XML nodes when the serialized document is parsed downstream.
flaw_origin: Commit 5fb8fb92b2cb9d7c6b8b5477900e90619b14e432 first added XMLSerializer/serializeToString and its COMMENT_NODE arm in dom.js, including the unsafe return buf.push("<!--",node.data,"-->") operation. This is the smallest public Git object that writes the flawed serialization mechanism; later formatting, moves, and serializer refactors preserve rather than originate it.
ai_marker: absent: BIC commit object author and committer are both jindw <jindw@xidea.org>; its commit message is empty and contains no Co-Authored-By, Generated-with, bot, or other AI trailer/marker
evidence: CVE.org API record for CVE-2026-41672 was checked on 2026-08-29: cveMetadata.state is PUBLISHED; CNA affected ranges are xmldom <= 0.6.0, @xmldom/xmldom < 0.8.13, and @xmldom/xmldom >= 0.9.0,<0.9.10, with references to both direct fixes and release tags.

git show 5fb8fb92b2cb9d7c6b8b5477900e90619b14e432 -- dom.js shows this commit adding XMLSerializer, serializeToString, and dom.js:810 COMMENT_NODE -> return buf.push("<!--",node.data,"-->") with no validation or escaping.

git grep -F '<!--' 5d770d4c04466fd4a99b0762d28b8d1d111ba0c7 -- '*.js' returned no match, while the same command on 5fb8fb92b2cb9d7c6b8b5477900e90619b14e432 returned only dom.js:810; direct parent-tree absence is therefore verified.

git log --all --follow -S'node.data,"-->"' -- lib/dom.js identifies 5fb8fb92b2cb9d7c6b8b5477900e90619b14e432 as the original first write, followed only by later style/refactor rewrites including 6601a11f0d7e9d237e1e5019af6a59297e6467a7 and c007c51909587990c962cf3d5c2acadf4c897b87; the 2020 lib/dom.js creation at 004d20c3437c5a998376e73f0c44a0f9201e308f is a zero-content rename from dom.js, not a BIC.

git cat-file commit 5fb8fb92b2cb9d7c6b8b5477900e90619b14e432 shows one parent, author jindw <jindw@xidea.org>, committer jindw <jindw@xidea.org>, and an empty message with no trailers; no commit-object AI marker exists.

On the 0.9.x line, direct fix fda7cc313de30243fea35cada64e0bb12099c2a1 adds a requireWellFormed guard rejecting invalid XML chars, '--', or a trailing '-' before COMMENT_NODE output. Its parent edf9f819e4178e0b9095920c88b43ef4ec418b06 still directly concatenates COMMENT_START,node.data,COMMENT_END.

On the 0.8.x LTS line, direct fix b397540889086da868c30c366ad5c220d1a750c7 adds a requireWellFormed guard for the injection-closing '-->' sequence. Its parent bd0edc90b6479658f3f0d3e33a035410aa5c7cbe still directly concatenates '<!--',node.data,'-->'.

Tag ancestry verifies the boundaries: fda7cc313de30243fea35cada64e0bb12099c2a1 is an ancestor of annotated tag 0.9.10 (peeled commit 7ffb16bce1170c7314151379531147637ab772a1) but not 0.9.9 (bf396a575c4dd32ce4bd925b849dcb7e778d957c); b397540889086da868c30c366ad5c220d1a750c7 is an ancestor of 0.8.13 (e5c14802592685bb872c042c54c3f73758875c85) but not 0.8.12 (189cb78a83e81e1515880988a399e863a8be85ac).

The BIC is an ancestor of release 0.6.0 (c80a161172cc4d8733583bf0cf59abfa589f6d9e), consistent with the CNA's affected legacy xmldom range; the advisory supplies no patched version for that legacy package.
The fixes are opt-in by design: both leave default serialization verbatim and protect applications only when requireWellFormed:true is passed, matching the advisory's stated residual limitation.
reasoning: The vulnerability is a syntax-context failure, not merely malformed formatting: createComment and CharacterData mutation can place '-->' in Comment.data, and the serializer emits that value between literal comment delimiters, letting attacker bytes terminate the comment and become XML structure. History search anchored on the vulnerable operation reaches 5fb8fb92b2cb9d7c6b8b5477900e90619b14e432, which first introduced both the serializer and exact unsafe COMMENT_NODE arm; its immediate parent has Comment support but no JavaScript '<!--' serialization at all. Later file movement, formatting, and walkDOM migration were excluded as non-originating transformations. The two direct branch fixes add opt-in requireWellFormed validation immediately before the same sink, and parent plus tag ancestry places them exactly at 0.8.13 and 0.9.10. The original xmldom <=0.6.0 package remains unpatched according to the published CNA record. Finally, only the BIC commit object was used for attribution: it is a single-parent human-authored/committed 2012 object with no message or AI marker, so the real vulnerability is NOT_AI.
remaining_gap: The legacy npm package xmldom <= 0.6.0 remains unpatched in the published advisory; users must migrate to @xmldom/xmldom and enable requireWellFormed:true at serialization sites that can receive untrusted comment data.

potential_fix.approach: Migrate to a patched @xmldom/xmldom release and pass { requireWellFormed: true } to every XML serialization path that may contain untrusted Comment.data.
potential_fix.rationale: The CNA lists no patched legacy xmldom version, while @xmldom/xmldom 0.8.13 and 0.9.10 contain branch-specific serialization guards; the guards remain opt-in and therefore must be enabled by the application.
